{{Top|leg}}
The '''Grand Lord's Hand''' was a position within the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s hierarchy on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], an isolated planet in the remote fringes [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Like the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]] utilized by other Sith empires, these Hands served as spies and secret agents of the ruling [[Grand Lord]] who operated outside conventional protocols. At some point, the Grand Lord [[Varner Hilts]] offered his daughter [[Takara Hilts]] the opportunity as serving as his own Hand. However, she declined the offer in favor of becoming the [[Prefect of Police|Prefect]] of the [[Tahv Constabulary]], a much lower position within the Sith establishment.

In [[2974 BBY]], Varner offered the former outcast and reluctant "savior" of the Tribe [[Parlan Spinner]] the same job. Spinner told Varner that he would consider the career option before departing for a date with his former&ndash;enemy&ndash;turned&ndash;lover Takara. Later, Varner privately expressed to his wife [[Grand Consort]] [[Iliana Hilts]] that he hoped that Spinner and Takara would serve as his new Hands in the future.
